text:
Ana Gomez: Hey team — quick sync on the Nimbus beta cohort: onboarding status, feedback cadence, and potential renewal flags. Can we confirm who owns next week's enablement webinar and the nudge schedule?

Devon Li: I can run the webinar (Wed 10am PT). I'll own the slide deck + live Q&A. @Taylor Kim can you handle invites, RSVP form, and the recording?

Taylor Kim: Yep — marking it on my calendar. I'll create an RSVP via Typeform and add the recording link. Question: do we want the webinar open to all trial seats or only active users (i.e., those with >=3 sessions)?

Maya Patel: Recommend active users only — we want quality Q&A and to surface success stories. Also let's invite the pilot champions from Nimbus specifically (product + integrations).

Ana Gomez: Agreed. Active users only. @onboard-bot can you post a reminder in #nimbus-pilot 24h before?

onboard-bot: Reminder scheduled: Webinar for Nimbus beta cohort on Wed 10:00 PT. Channel: #nimbus-pilot. Reminder: 24h before and 1h before. RSVP link: https://redwood.typeform.com/nimbus-webinar

Taylor Kim: RSVP link posted. Draft nudge cadence: Day 0 (welcome), Day 3 (tips + quickstart), Day 7 (webinar invite), Day 10 (feedback survey). Thoughts?

Devon Li: Looks good. Can we add a short pre-webinar survey (1-2 q) to collect top issues so I can tailor slides? Add `What integration blockers are you seeing?` and `Primary success metric for pilot`.

Taylor Kim: Added the two questions to RSVP form. Preview: 
```
1) What integration blockers are you seeing? (free text)
2) Primary success metric for the pilot (select: latency, cost, accuracy, other)
```

Maya Patel: Also — we saw one account with low usage last week (account id: NMB-448). Ana, can you triage whether it's a product issue vs. enablement gap? If usage doesn't pick up by EOW, we should mark as a renewal risk and open an action plan.

Ana Gomez: On it. I pinged the CSM for that account and scheduled a 30m sync for tomorrow. If we don't see a response or improvement by Friday COB, I'll escalate as "medium" renewal risk and propose a workspace health play (concierge session + integration bug triage).

Devon Li: For feedback capture post-webinar, let's use a short NPS-style pulse + 3 quick qual questions. I can wire results into the Beta Feedback board (project: CS-Beta-Feedback).

Taylor Kim: I'll set up automatic export from Typeform -> Google Sheet -> short script to create cards in CS-Beta-Feedback. Script snippet I used last time: 
```
# pseudo
export typeform -> gsheets
if response['blocker'] contains 'auth' -> label: auth
else -> label: general
create_card(project='CS-Beta-Feedback')
```

Maya Patel: Nice. Action items recap: 
- Devon: Webinar content + live Q&A (due Tue EOD)
- Taylor: RSVP, pre-webinar survey, reminders (done) + export automation (due Wed afternoon)
- Ana: Triage NMB-448 and flag renewal risk by Fri COB if no improvement
- Maya: Prepare playbook snippet for "concierge session" to attach to action plan

Ana Gomez: I'll also add a short adoption threshold to the playbook: if active seats < 30% of licensed by day 14 -> trigger outreach.

Devon Li: Quick ask — can someone pull last week's telemetry for Nimbus (avg session length, API error rate)? I want a 1-slide ops snapshot.

onboard-bot: Telemetry report (auto) attached: 1788881255-nimbus-weekly-telemetry.csv (s3 link)

Taylor Kim: Got it. I'll include the slide with the top-3 asks pulled from the pre-webinar survey.

Maya Patel: One more: let's make the post-webinar feedback window 72h (short pulses get better response). If negative trends appear, we'll trigger a rapid follow-up with the integration engineer.

Ana Gomez: Sounds good. I'll schedule a follow-up 72h after the webinar to review feedback and decide on escalation. If anyone wants to change their ownership, shout now. Otherwise I'll close the loop after the follow-up meeting. :white_check_mark:

Devon Li: All set from my side. Thanks team! :raised_hands:
